summary: Full e2e verification of the 4-phase feature drop (appointment types, clickable stat cards, bulk/single delete without confirm, patient deep-dive). 10/10 backend pytest tests PASS and every claimed data-testid is present in the UI. Single delete verified removes the item from the list (8→7) with ZERO browser confirm dialogs triggered across the entire test run.

issues: Many cards show patient name 'Unknown' (~5 of 8). These are pre-existing orphan appointments already flagged in iteration_24 — appts referencing deleted/missing patient_ids. Not a regression from this iteration but still visible to users; consider hiding orphans or backfilling.

critical_code_review_comments: appointments.py bulk_delete_appointments correctly filters deletable ids in Python and issues a single delete_many — good. RBAC uses created_by_id with a graceful fallback to None-owner. Verified by TestRBAC.
notes.py bulk-delete uses author name (not id) for ownership check. This works but is fragile if a user is renamed. Consider migrating to author_id like appointments did.
forms.py bulk-delete uses created_by (name). Same fragility as notes.
messages.py bulk-delete correctly scopes to sender/recipient for non-admin; uses a single query, efficient.
assistant.py bulk-delete scoped by user_id — correct isolation.
Frontend bulk.js helper (per description) shows toast on skipped items — verified via TestRBAC (staff cannot delete admin appointment, skipped=1).
Dashboard stat cards navigate with proper query params (?status=unpaid, ?date=today, ?status=pending) and target pages honor them (invoice-status-filter and clear-form-filter render). Good.
seed_data_creation: Tests create/tear-down a TEST_Iter25 patient plus throwaway appointments, notes, forms, messages, assistant conversations, and one throwaway doctor user for RBAC. All cleaned up in fixtures except a few TEST_ appointments left by the RBAC path (admin cleanup at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_25.py for regression on Phase 1-3. FormInput.fields is a dict (not list) — use {} not []. Register new users via POST /api/auth/register (not /api/users). UI verified: 8 appt-type badges, 2 join-video buttons (only on telehealth), 215 note delete buttons, 282 form checkboxes, patient-detail modal with detail-appts/notes/forms + detail-filter-provider/type all present. NO browser confirm dialogs across entire delete workflow.

phase_verification.phase_1_appointment_types: PASS — af-type-in-person/telehealth toggles present in new-appt modal; appt-type-<id> badges visible; join-video-<id> only on telehealth; filter-type + filter-provider both present and backend query params work.
phase_verification.phase_2_clickable_stats: PASS — stat-card-unpaidInvoices → /invoices?status=unpaid + invoice-status-filter; stat-card-apptToday → /appointments?date=today; stat-card-pendingForms → /forms?status=pending + clear-form-filter badge.
phase_verification.phase_3_bulk_and_single_delete_no_confir: PASS — 0 browser confirm dialogs triggered. Single delete verified (8→7 items). bulk-delete-appts appears on selection. bulk-delete endpoints for appts/notes/forms/messages/assistant all return {deleted, skipped}. RBAC: staff cannot delete admin-created appt (skipped=1).
phase_verification.phase_4_patient_deep_dive: PASS — view-patient-<id> opens patient-detail modal with detail-appts, detail-notes, detail-forms sections and detail-filter-provider + detail-filter-type dropdowns all present.
